opinions.text: November 15, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied. Mr. H. A. Toulmiri and Mr. H. A. Toulmin, Jr., for petitioner. Mr. Albert E. Dieterich for respondents.
